title: Customizing Command/Group/Option classes via cls and class attributes
answers: How can the Command class be customized?
How do I make @group.command() use a custom Command class?
What do command_class and group_class do?
body:
- `@click.command(cls=MyCommand, **attrs)`: `cls` replaces `Command` in `decorators.py:command`; extra attrs go to `MyCommand.__init__`. Likewise `@option(cls=MyOption)`, `@argument(cls=MyArgument)`.
- `cls` cannot be combined with the bare `@command` form (assert in `command`).
- `core.py:Group.command_class` / `Group.group_class` are defaults injected into `kwargs['cls']` by `Group.command` / `Group.group` when caller passes none (~core.py:1779, 1828). `group_class = type` means subgroups use the parent group's own class.
- `core.py:Command.context_class` (class attr) selects the Context class used in `Command.make_context`.
